item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 20/Mar/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A southerly airstream will bring warm and humid weather and showers to the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. A trough of low pressure is expected to bring unsettled weather to Guangdong areas in the latter part of this week. Showers will increase and there will be squally thunderstorms over the region. A surge of the northeast monsoon will bring slightly cooler weather to southern China over the weekend and early next week.
